text:
Grok Bot has became one of my favorite tools

I wanted high-quality Odyssey movie visuals with Grok Imagine

Normally, you’d need to research the story, plan the scenes, characters, costumes, locations, and camera angles.....then write every prompt yourself

With Grok Bot, I just asked it to create the visuals

It researched The Odyssey, planned the scenes, wrote the prompts, generated the shots with Grok Imagine, organized everything and saved it to my folder

The results were amazingly good

This is the difference between prompting an image model and having an AI teammate handle the entire creative workflow for you

Research → story → prompts → visuals → folder

it is a total game changer
